source: MyBatis 글·태그 저장 대체 구현 — 1-5 단계 DB에서 C1~C11 검증

files.content:
spring:
  application:
    name: javaExperience
  datasource:
    # javaExperience MySQL의 community DB. 시작하기 안내대로 javaExperience DB를 먼저 띄운다
    url: jdbc:mysql://localhost:13308/community?characterEncoding=UTF-8&serverTimezone=Asia/Seoul
    username: community
    password: community
  jpa:
    hibernate:
      # 테이블은 docker/mysql/init/ 의 dump가 만든다. 엔티티가 테이블과 다르면 기동이 실패한다(테이블을 몰래 바꾸지 않음)
      ddl-auto: validate
    # 트랜잭션이 끝나면 커넥션을 바로 반납한다(컨트롤러·직렬화 단계까지 붙잡지 않음)
    open-in-view: false
    properties:
      hibernate:
        format_sql: true

logging:
  level:
    # 실행되는 SQL과 바인딩 값 — 쿼리가 몇 번 나가는지(N+1) 볼 때 쓴다
    org.hibernate.SQL: debug
    org.hibernate.orm.jdbc.bind: trace

mybatis:
  mapper-locations: classpath:mapper/*.xml
  configuration:
    map-underscore-to-camel-case: true

# 0-6 — 내가 정한 설정 값. 코드에서 @Value("${start.greeting}")로 읽는다
start:
  greeting: 반가워요, 백엔드!
  max-items: 5

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.post.PostCreationMapper">
    <select id="findBoardBySlug" resultType="org.example.post.BoardWriteRow">
        SELECT id, slug, write_role FROM board WHERE slug = #{slug}
    </select>
    <select id="findAuthorById" resultType="org.example.post.AuthorWriteRow">
        SELECT id, nickname, role FROM member WHERE id = #{id}
    </select>
    <insert id="insertPost" parameterType="org.example.post.PostInsert" useGeneratedKeys="true" keyProperty="id">
        INSERT INTO post (board_id, author_id, title, content, status, visibility,
                          view_count, like_count, comment_count, published_at,
                          created_at, updated_at, deleted_at)
        VALUES (#{boardId}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, 'PUBLISHED', #{visibility},
                0, 0, 0, #{now}, #{now}, #{now}, NULL)
    </insert>
    <insert id="insertTagIfAbsent">
        INSERT INTO tag (name, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{now})
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
    </insert>
    <select id="findTagByName" resultType="org.example.post.TagWriteRow">
        SELECT id, name FROM tag WHERE name = #{name}
    </select>
    <insert id="linkTag">
        INSERT INTO post_tag (post_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{tagId})
    </insert>
</mapper>
